method: Unchanged compare_reference metrics, five native Camera frames per scene at normalized times 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.
limitations: This artifact verifies desktop OpenGL rendering, not Minecraft integration.
Only five supplied keyframes per scene are compared, not all intermediate times.
Curve chains and distance-based borders approximate native analytic fills and strip geometry.
Float32 signed alpha approximates ordered native FP16 blending.
Known narrow native skip-marker windows may differ between keyframes.
Chinese coverage is limited to the bundled Song font subset and these two scenes.
LaTeX coverage is limited to the two explicit supported examples and the pinned toolchain.

observations: The largest Chinese foreground-mask differences occur at the Chinese-text endpoint: t=0 for chinese_change and t=2 for chinese_math.
A midpoint-only thumbnail does not represent the worst Chinese frame; chinese-lowest-iou-comparison.png supplies those endpoint comparisons.
No renderer changes or threshold tuning were made during final delivery verification.

Visual inspection of the lowest-IoU endpoint crops shows faint triangular gray regions in native ManimGL counter spaces and beside strokes; compiled endpoints keep these spaces black. The principal white Chinese strokes are present in both. The underlying native artifact cause was not experimentally isolated in this delivery check.
